what: Diagnosis of the 6 open findings in authored-fix-recheck.json, 2026-08-13. Each was diagnosed against the LIVE data, then a skeptic tried to refute the proposed remedy. 1 survived, 5 were refuted — and the refutations found live defects that were NOT in the original findings.     feats/gift-of-the-moon: "Cast from this feat, the spell uses your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. At 15th level you cast it at 6th rank; …"
    feats/nocturnal-kindred: "Cast from this feat, the spell uses your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and the creatures it summons are bats, rats, and wolves."
    feats/manipulative-charm: "Cast from this feat, Charm uses your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait."

  Two invariants the seven share: the DC wording is TRANSCRIBED from that record's own sentence, never normalised (pact-of-fey-glamour keeps "the higher of your class DC and your spell DC"; the rest keep "your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher"); and same-record riders about the same spell are FOLDED INTO THE SAME NOTE rather than left out (manipulative-charm's visual trait, nocturnal-kindred's summon list, righteous-resistance's "only on yourself").

(c) THE SWEEP — SIX IS THE REAL NUMBER, but the "8 that do" is really 7.
Method: walked every collection in public/core.json, kept every record carrying `innateSpells` AT ANY DEPTH (405 records: 316 feats, 53 items, 27 heritages, 9 backgrounds — the deep walk found 27 more than a top-level check), read each record's text from the AoN mirror by aonId with a fallback to the parent file for compound `equipment-NNNN-MMMM` ids and to core-descriptions.json for the 5 with no aonId, then matched the DC-choice phrasings. Separately swept ALL 43k+ records' text for the choice phrasing to catch a record that prints it but carries no innateSpells field at all.
234 records print a class-DC/spell-DC choice. 15 of them grant an innate spell:
  CARRY A NOTE (7): gift-of-the-moon, manipulative-charm, nocturnal-kindred, realm-strider, lingering-echoes, borrow-memories, pact-of-fey-glamour.
  NO NOTE, clause governs THEIR OWN INNATE SPELL (6): animal-magic, innocent-butterfly, dominating-gaze, tengu-feather-fan, kaijus-footfalls, pact-of-eldritch-eyes. ← exactly the six named.
  NO NOTE, but the clause governs a granted ACTIVATION/ACTION and NOT the innate spell (2, correctly excluded):
    items/pact-of-the-herald-and-host — innate spell is `fear` with no DC clause; the choice belongs to its "Activate—Breath of the Dragon" ("Each creature in the area must attempt a basic saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC").
    heritages/elytron-surki — innate spell is `fly`; the choice belongs to the granted Stridulating Song action ("a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC (whichever is higher)"). Its `innateSpells:[{spellId:'fly'}]` is bare and its own printed "targeting yourself" is likewise unauthored, but that is a different clause.
The recheck's "8 that do" counted feats/righteous-resistance, whose note does say "whichever is higher" — but about a RESISTANCE VALUE ("equal to either the spell's normal value or your level"), not a DC. Corrected count: 6 against 7.
Also checked and correctly out of scope: items/trident-of-the-azarketis + greater ("The spell DC is 29." — a fixed item DC, not a choice); feats/first-frost, feats/sound-mirror, heritages/spellhorn-kobold ("You're trained in spell attack modifier and spell DC" — the profSpell lane); the remaining 219 of the 234 grant no spell at all (they are actions/abilities whose DC is the choice — see needsOwnerRuling).
diagnosis.needsOwnerRuling: The sweep turned up 219 records that print the SAME clause ("a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher") for a granted ACTION or item ACTIVATION rather than for a spell — feats/breath-of-the-dragon, feats/kobold-breath, actions/stridulating-song, items/pact-of-the-herald-and-host, heritages/elytron-surki and so on. There is no spell to hang a spellNote on, and "the higher of the two" is a third number printed nowhere on the sheet — the exact shape `specialStatistic.basis.higherOfClassDcOrSpellDc` was built for (Q30/Round 10, the deviation DC). But none of them NAMES a statistic, which is the lane's own entry test, and Ruling D says a target-side DC gets no surface. So: does a granted action whose DC is "the higher of your class DC or spell DC" get a surface at all (a marker on the action per Ruling D, or a specialStatistic row), or nothing? Do not act on this without a ruling — it is a 219-record lane, not a residual. Secondary, one record only: Kaiju's Footfalls prints "At 17th level, you can CHOOSE to heighten this innate enlarge spell to 4th rank" — `heightenAt` would FORCE the step (4th-rank Enlarge makes you Huge, which a player may not want), so the remedy below puts that sentence in the note as prose and authors no `heightenAt`. Confirm that is the right call before anyone adds `heightenAt:[{level:17,rank:4}]`.

verdict.why:
REFUTED on step 1, which I measured doing collateral damage they never flagged, and on a load-bearing sentence in their own diagnosis that is false.

(1) Their `SUPERSEDED_BY` destroys Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting — measured, not argued. `archetypeTraditionOptions` for the legal set ['magaambyan-attendant-dedication','halcyon-speaker-dedication','cascade-bearers-spellcasting',…] returns TODAY ["arcane","primal","divine","occult"]; with the Attendant superseded it returns ["arcane","primal"]. That widening IS the feat's whole printed benefit (core-descriptions, feats/cascade-bearers-spellcasting: "You can select halcyon spells from the divine or occult spell lists in additional to the arcane or primal spell lists"), and it lives only in the Attendant's `traditionOptionFeats` (casterArchetypes.ts:152) — halcyon's config has none. Worse, cascade-bearers-spellcasting carries `spellSlotBonus:{entryId:"magaambyan-attendant-dedication-casting",cantrips:1}`, so deleting that entry orphans it through build.ts:3981's exact `entryId ? find(...) → undefined → continue` — the remedy MOVES the bug it diagnoses onto a different feat. They flagged only "it DROPS the Attendant's one innate cantrip (AoN feat-1102)"; the larger loss is a level-10 feat whose printed text is explicitly about halcyon spells, i.e. the same pool.

(2) Their claim about the ★ toggle is false. They write: "`sigAvailable` (:557-558) … requires the CLASS's `signature-spells` feature — so it never renders for an archetype entry". `sigAvailable` is computed from the CLASS, not the entry: `spontaneous && (cls?.features ?? []).some((f) => f.featureId === 'signature-spells' && f.level <= character.level)`. Measured: bard, sorcerer, psychic and oracle all return true, and a bard L18 with the halcyon chain builds three entries including `halcyon-speaker-dedication-casting` (spontaneous, in `mains`). So the toggle DOES render on that entry, `toggleSig` calls `setSignatureSpells(p, entry.id, …)`, and play.ts:360 is whole-list replacement — `signature: play.signatureSpells?.[e.id] ?? e.signature` — so the first ★ a bard-host player touches on the halcyon entry silently erases the authored field-of-life signature. Their only measurements used a fighter host, the one class where their sentence happens to hold.

(3) The remedy leaves the sentence half-modelled. The printed clause is an EXCEPTION: "you treat the field of life halcyon spell gained from this feat as a signature spell, **even though halcyon spells normally can't be signature spells**" (feat-7744.json, verified). Nothing enforces the rule it excepts — per (2) a bard/sorcerer/psychic/oracle host can already star any halcyon spell — so on exactly those four hosts the feat's benefit is zero and the authored value is destructible. Q27 ("an option that cannot be picked must LOOK unpickable") governs, and the remedy is silent.

(4) Mis-scoped. Blocker 1 is not a Vellumis defect; it is the whole Halcyon Speaker archetype. Measured L16 with the legal set: the only entry is `magaambyan-attendant-dedication-casting`, type innate, `repertoire {}`, `slots undefined` — ranks 1-5, expert proficiency, Initiate and Adept all inert. `checkPrerequisites(feats['halcyon-speaker-dedication'], …)` returns `{"met":false,"unmet":["Magaambyan Attendant Dedication"]}`, so EVERY legal speaker is in that state. Burying that under a Vellumis ticket with a one-line supersede is how it stays buried.
